# A415 Baroque anchor

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:pitchAnchorA415`](gmeow-pitchAnchorA415.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/pitchAnchorA415>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)

A historical Baroque pitch anchor: 12-EDO degree 69 = 415 Hz. The same lattice as A440, but a different anchor ([Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11)).
